title: A Wardrobe for the Postcards
author: Sable Quintana
blurb: Mirabel Halloran, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
